name: Zakat Foundation of America
mission: To not merely to aid — but to enrich — the poor. We seek to serve our One Creator by serving all of His creation.
theoryOfChange: The Zakat Foundation of America utilizes a documented strategic framework, referred to as a "professional framework" in their "Zakat Foundation of America Sept 2025" document. This framework translates eight categories into specific "Impact Areas" including Poverty Alleviation, Food Security, Health & Well-being, Orphan & Widow Support, and Emergency & Disaster Relief. It details a "Programmatic Implementation and Methodology" focused on eradicating poverty and fostering self-sufficiency through initiatives like education, vocational training, and asset acquisition. The framework is rooted in Islamic principles and incorporates "Internal Controls and Accountability" to ensure transparent tracking of Zakat funds. Their annual reports (e.g., 2022, 2021-2022, 2024) further elaborate on their mission, vision, and strategic planning, highlighting community-building programs and efforts to alleviate hunger. The GuideStar profile also outlines their strategies for providing immediate relief and establishing long-term development projects. While a specific document titled "Theory of Change" or "Logic Model" was not found, the described "professional framework" and its components align with the characteristics of an impact framework or a comprehensive program strategy.

strengths_deep_dive: Zakat Foundation of America demonstrates a high capacity for direct service delivery, particularly in high-conflict zones. In 2024, the organization reported treating <cite id="14">11,200 patients in Gaza</cite> and providing <cite id="15">vocational training to 16,571 individuals</cite> to foster long-term self-sufficiency. Their financial model is lean, as evidenced by a <cite id="16">fundraising efficiency of $0.04 per $1 raised</cite>, which allows more resources to be funneled into their <cite id="17">$21.2 million in total grants</cite> distributed globally.
rich_narrative.summary: Zakat Foundation of America is a humanitarian organization that has operated for over <cite id="1">two decades since its founding in 2001</cite>. The charity focuses on both immediate emergency relief and long-term development projects to support vulnerable communities globally. Its operations are characterized by high financial efficiency, reporting a <cite id="2">program expense ratio of 91.6%</cite>, which exceeds the <cite id="3">industry standard of 75%</cite>. This ensures that the vast majority of donor funds reach those in need. However, a significant concern is the age of public data; <cite id="4">no financial filings newer than FY2023 are available</cite>. Donors should treat this three-year-old financial picture with caution as it may not reflect the current fiscal state. Despite this, the organization maintains a <cite id="5">Gold Seal of Transparency from Candid</cite> and demonstrates strong fundraising efficiency, spending only <cite id="6">$0.04 to raise every $1</cite>. Its impact is broad, reaching regions such as <cite id="7">Gaza, Sudan, and Yemen</cite> with essential services including <cite id="8">orphan sponsorship for 4,715 children</cite> and the distribution of over <cite id="9">11 million Ramadan meals</cite> in recent cycles.
